articles.title: Why Do Cats Lick Each Other? It's Not Always Friendship!
articles.summary: Cats lick each other for many reasons — and friendship is only one of them. Scientists watched 53 pairs of cats and found licking can also calm a tense moment or even start a wrestling match.

articles.title: AI Boss Says We Need to Slow Down Before Bots Take Over the Internet
articles.summary: The CEO of Anthropic, Dario Amodei, wrote a plan asking companies and the U.S. government to slow down AI development. He worries a swarm of AI bots could take over the internet in 6 to 12 months.

articles.title: El Tiny Is Back! Latin Music Stars Take Over NPR's Tiny Desk
articles.summary: NPR's Tiny Desk becomes El Tiny for Hispanic Heritage Month, with a 2026 lineup featuring Los Tigres del Norte, Mon Laferte, Draco Rosa, and more. The series runs from Sept. 15 to Oct. 15.
